title: Accurate and Low-Cost Cardiac Disorder Detection from Wearable Phonocardiogram Signals Using Hybrid Feature Selection and Machine Learning.
summary: mRMR/ReliefF/Kruskal-Wallis feature selection with k-NN/SVM/Bagged Tree; PSO/ACO optimize selected subsets. Results reports 99.80% accuracy and 99.50% F1 for Kruskal-Wallis+k-NN; validation is benchmark-dataset evaluation as stated in paper.
ai_technology: mRMR/ReliefF/Kruskal-Wallis feature selection with k-NN/SVM/Bagged Tree; PSO/ACO optimize selected subsets.
organization: Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Zonguldak Bülent Ecevit University, Zonguldak 67100, Türkiye

evidence.tested: Benchmark-dataset evaluation reported 99.80% accuracy and 99.50% F1 for Kruskal–Wallis feature selection with k-nearest neighbors; the result is limited to the reported dataset.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study
evidence.ai_role: mRMR/ReliefF/Kruskal-Wallis feature selection with k-NN/SVM/Bagged Tree; PSO/ACO optimize selected subsets.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
